content.what_it_is: Fortran boundary/halo module containing BOUNDARY_CONDITION (L52-L295), which imposes edge and land-mask momentum fluxes; EXCHANGE_DISPERSION (L305-L414), which selects symmetry types and exchanges derivative fields; EXCHANGE (L426-L529), which exchanges primary fields, masks velocities, and optionally filters them; PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH (L539-L617), which mirrors ghost cells for staggered-length arrays; and PHI_COLL (L630-L1272), which implements periodic MPI exchange plus VTYPE 1-6 mirror, antisymmetric, or zero ghost conditions.
entities: SUBROUTINE PHI_COLL with CARTESIAN PERIODIC argument @L631

unresolved: PHI_COLL first installs periodic y ghost cells when PERIODIC is true at L669-L759, but only the VTYPE 1-3 y-boundary blocks are guarded by .NOT.PERIODIC (L801-L1027); the VTYPE 4-6 y blocks at L1032-L1266 subsequently zero, mirror, or negate those periodic ghosts, so PERIODIC is ineffective for those selector values.

BOUNDARY_CONDITION loops over Ibeg-1:Iend+1 and Jbeg-1:Jend+1 at L221-L293, then accesses MASK(I-1,J) at L235, P(I+1,J) at L241, MASK(I+1,J) at L252, Q(I,J+1) at L275, and MASK(I,J+1) at L287; this requires at least two valid ghost layers but the subroutine contains no Nghost/range check.

The CARTESIAN branch of EXCHANGE_DISPERSION conditionally exchanges time-dispersion fields ETAT/ETATx/ETATy or Ut/Vt and their derivatives inside Gamma2>ZERO (L328-L376), while the non-CARTESIAN branch L380-L411 has no corresponding time-field exchanges, leaving compile-time branches with different halo-update interfaces.

PHI_COLL accepts arbitrary VTYPE at L653 but has only independent IF blocks for values 1 through 6 (L763-L1266) and no rejection/default path; an out-of-range selector silently skips local physical-boundary fills before the parallel phi_exch call at L1269.
Parallel locals nreq, ll, l, myvar, and mybeta are declared at L661-L664 but not assigned or referenced through L1272.
